I wanted to share the plan for Saturday's volunteer shift. We will meet at the library courtyard at nine, then walk to the food pantry together so nobody has to find the entrance alone. Please wear closed shoes because the storage room floor can be dusty, and bring a water bottle if you have one. We still need one person to drive the donated boxes to the west side location after noon.

If you cannot come after all, please reply by Friday evening so I can adjust the sign-in sheet.

Thank you for helping with this.

Warmly,
Rina
